'''Vette's slicing boots''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]]. They were [[red]] in color with [[Silver/Legends|silver]] rims.
